summary.en: Unofficial FFmpeg build with a winarm64 package.
summary.zh-TW: 提供 winarm64 套件的非官方 FFmpeg 建置版本。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Result rests on the winget manifest, which lists an Arm64 installer; the vendor page could not be read from this environment.
caveats.zh-TW: 結果依據 winget 資訊清單所列的 Arm64 安裝檔；此環境無法讀取原廠頁面。
